final: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings AS cs JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.country), all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS value FROM country_averages), above_all AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_averages AS ca CROSS JOIN all_mean AS m WHERE ca.avg_wins > m.value), above_all_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS value FROM above_all) SELECT AVG(a.avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(a.avg_wins - m.value) AS mean_excess_over_all_countries, AVG(a.avg_wins - g.value) AS mean_excess_over_above_average_countries FROM above_all AS a CROSS JOIN all_mean AS m CROSS JOIN above_all_mean AS g WHERE a.avg_wins > g.value
